name: Mii Amo
insider_take: This destination spa sits on sacred Yavapai land among Sedona's mystical red rocks, where ancient energy vortexes are believed to promote healing and spiritual awakening.
whats_special: Mii Amo is consistently ranked among the world's top destination spas, featuring treatments inspired by Native American traditions and Sedona's natural energy. The property's name means "journey" in the Yuman language, reflecting its focus on personal transformation. Each casita offers stunning views of the red rock formations, including Cathedral Rock and Bell Rock.
pro_tip: Book the Crystal Grotto treatment room, built into natural rock formations with amethyst and quartz crystals embedded in the walls for an otherworldly spa experience.
dont_miss: The sunrise meditation at Airport Mesa vortex (just 10 minutes away), stargazing from your private deck, and the signature Sedona clay wrap using mineral-rich local red clay. The nearby Chapel of the Holy Cross, built directly into the red rocks in 1956, offers breathtaking panoramic views of the valley.
pros: World-class destination spa in stunning Sedona red rock setting
Transformative wellness programs and holistic healing experiences
Exceptional personalized service and intimate boutique atmosphere
Luxurious casitas with private outdoor spaces and canyon views
